name: Restronics Southeast
old_description: We are a consultative OEM sales rep organization, where we help educate our customers to improve their processes and productivity.
about:
Restronics Southeast was founded in 1991 in Acworth, Georgia. The company operates as a national manufacturers' representative, led by Managing Partner Tim Glasgow, who brings 35 years of industry experience. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

Rather than producing goods, Restronics provides consultative sales and engineering services to original equipment manufacturers. Its service portfolio includes ESD facility assessments, workstation evaluations, static bag testing, and assembly line consultation for both surface-mount and through-hole processes. The firm represents a roster of electronic-component manufacturers and manages distribution-channel relationships across a territory covering Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee, Mississippi, and Arkansas.

The primary customers are OEMs in the electronics manufacturing sector seeking to improve process efficiency, reduce field failures, and optimize capital investment. Restronics' sales engineers work directly with engineering and procurement teams to identify ESD vulnerabilities and recommend equipment or process changes.

The company emphasizes credibility with both customers and principals as its core asset, offering no-charge assessment services and honest, timely information to help manufacturers increase profitability. This consultative approach, rooted in long-standing industry relationships, is presented as the reason clients engage Restronics.
